subject: Vendr profile stewardship & ownership handoff checklist
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire@vendr.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile - request to transfer steward + evidence mapping

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Trying to tidy up Northpoint's Vendr listing and we have a change request: the listed profile steward is still tied to an old Ops alias and Northpoint asked us to make Mina the official profile owner so portal notifications and evidence requests route there.

Quick ask: can Mina accept profile ownership in Vendr and confirm the following items so Northpoint can close their intake?
- Confirm steward email is mina.haddad@redwood.com (SAML principal)
- Upload a current SOC 2 snapshot (we only need a cover + date)
- Add an internal contact for escalation (name + phone)

I attached the Vendr ownership transfer form to this email. Once you sign it we can update the profile immediately. If you prefer, we can grant a temporary steward role for 7 days and we can do the migration on our side.

Attachments: vendr-ownership-form.pdf (fillable), soc2-snapshot-2027Q2.pdf (summary)

Thanks,
Claire Zhou
Partner Success, Vendr
claire@vendr.co


From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@vendr.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile - request to transfer steward + evidence mapping

Claire — thanks for the clear checklist. We can take this on but want to coordinate a couple of items before we sign anything: 

1) Steward identity: please use Mina Haddad (mina.haddad@redwood.com). This is a SAML federated principal tied to our IdP, not a mailbox alias.
2) Evidence handling: we prefer not to upload full SOC artifacts into third-party portals. We'll upload the SOC cover + date (the attached PDF) and then provide a signed possession attestation via the ownership form.
3) Escalation contact: Marissa will be the escalation lead (Marissa Cole, +1 (415) 555-0142).

Operational request: can Vendr send the profile role change as an action link (one-click accept) or do we need to return the filled PDF? A one-click flow is easier for our rotation controls.

I attached our redacted SOC cover; Marissa and Jonas — please confirm the escalation phone and that we are comfortable with the attestation approach.

--
Mina Haddad
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

> Claire — thanks for the clear checklist. We can take this on but want to coordinate a couple of items before we sign anything:

> Operational request: can Vendr send the profile role change as an action link (one-click accept) or do we need to return the filled PDF? A one-click flow is easier for our rotation controls.

Claire — one-click would be ideal. If that's not supported, we'll fill and sign the PDF and send it back.

Separately: Jonas and I reviewed the SOC snapshot; looks fine. Jonas, please confirm we can safely list a redacted S3 presign for logs (we won't store full logs in Vendr). If yes, I'll submit the ownership form and Mina will accept in the portal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile - request to transfer steward + evidence mapping

Marissa / Mina / Claire —

Confirmed: we can provide a time-limited S3 presign URL that points to a redacted artifacts bundle (cover page + index file). No logs or raw artifacts will be uploaded to Vendr. I'll generate the presign and share it in a separate secure message once the ownership change is queued.

Claire: one-click role transfer would be ideal. If you need a signed PDF we will return it (signed by Mina) within the same business day.

Next steps (summary):
- Claire to attempt a one-click steward transfer to Mina's SAML principal (mina.haddad@redwood.com)
- If transfer link not possible, Mina will sign & return vendr-ownership-form.pdf (signed)
- Jonas will post an S3 presign for the redacted SOC cover when asked by Vendr
- Marissa will be listed as escalation contact on the profile

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
